description: The plot illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter N on the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage across five different configurations, each represented by a distinct colored line with unique markers. The x-axis, labeled “N,” spans from 0 to 20 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “AUC (%)”, ranges from 75 to 100 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 5. The blue line with circle markers starts at approximately 94% at N=0, rises to 98.5% at N=5, remains flat until N=10, then declines gradually to about 94% at N=20. The orange line with diamond markers begins at 84% at N=0, increases steadily to 95% at N=10, then plateaus slightly before ending at 94.5% at N=20. The green line with star markers starts at 86.5% at N=0, rises to 92% at N=5, continues climbing to 94.5% at N=15, and ends at 92% at N=20. The red line with square markers begins at 87.5% at N=0, increases to 98.5% at N=10, then declines to 91% at N=20. The purple line with triangle markers remains nearly flat at 79.5% from N=0 to N=5, jumps sharply to 96.5% at N=10, then drops to 85.5% at N=15 and further to 82.5% at N=20.
